senses.gloss:
ओ 1. ओ, the vowel ओ, the thirteenth letter
of the alphabet.
—ओ-कार, अस्, m. the letter or
sound ओ.

ओ 2. ओ, ind. a vocative particle, Oh; an
interjection of calling, Ho, Holla; of reminiscence,
Ho, Ah; of compassion, Ah, Oh.
ओ 3. ओ, औस्, m. a N. of Brahmā.

ओ 4. ओ (आ-उ), only occurring in the past pass.
part.
—१. ओत, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. invoked, summoned.
